_comment: Canonical POST /sandboxes 201 body, captured from the real api.e2b.app on 2026-09-03. Note what is ABSENT: no metadata, no startedAt, no state. Only the list endpoint carries those. A driver that reads them here works against a generous fake and fails against the real service, so the fake must serve exactly this and no more.

_secret_fields._comment: envdAccessToken is a live credential for the created sandbox. The driver uses it once, to deliver the bootstrap file through the sandbox's envd file API, and must never log, persist, or propagate it beyond that request. The fake serves a per-sandbox value and requires it on POST /files.
